stories.title: Saudi minister thanks leadership as Cabinet approves national SME strategy

en.title: Saudi minister thanks leadership as Cabinet approves national SME strategy
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Cabinet has approved a National Strategy for Entrepreneurship and Small and Medium Enterprises. The strategy is designed to develop the entrepreneurship ecosystem and support enterprise growth.

stories.title: Champions League finals set for Munich in 2028 and Barcelona in 2029

en.title: Champions League finals set for Munich in 2028 and Barcelona in 2029
en.summary: UEFA has designated Munich as the host city for the 2028 Champions League final and Barcelona for the 2029 final, marking a return of these competitions to these venues.

stories.title: Saudi Crown Prince, Egyptian President Hold Bilateral Meeting, Expanded Talks

en.title: Saudi Crown Prince, Egyptian President Hold Bilateral Meeting, Expanded Talks
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Crown Prince and Egypt's President conducted bilateral and expanded discussions.

stories.title: Midday outdoor work ban under sun comes to an end in Saudi Arabia

en.title: Midday outdoor work ban under sun comes to an end in Saudi Arabia
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's three-month ban on outdoor work in direct sunlight during midday hours ended on September 15, having been in effect since June 15 for private sector workers.

stories.title: Arab Parliament Condemns Terrorist Houthi Militia Attacks on Saudi Arabia

en.title: Arab Parliament Condemns Terrorist Houthi Militia Attacks on Saudi Arabia
en.summary: The Arab Parliament issued a condemnation of what it characterizes as terrorist attacks by the Houthi militia against Saudi Arabia.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia ends 2026 midday work ban

en.title: Saudi Arabia ends 2026 midday work ban
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Ministry of Human Resources and Social Development concluded its temporary ban on outdoor work during peak heat hours, which had restricted private-sector work from noon to 3 p.m. between June and September for worker safety.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia, Egypt affirm shared interests, ‘absolute understanding’ on common goals

en.title: Saudi Arabia, Egypt affirm shared interests, 'absolute understanding' on common goals
en.summary: Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman and Egyptian President Abdel Fattah El-Sisi held talks in Cairo affirming that both nations share common interests and security concerns, with Egypt viewing Gulf security as integral to its own national security.

stories.title: Why Iraq’s militias will keep their weapons

en.title: Why Iraq's militias will keep their weapons
en.summary: As the United States prepares to complete its withdrawal from Iraq by September 30, Iraqi militias are expected to retain their weapons despite Baghdad's goal of state monopoly over armaments, reportedly due to Iranian influence.

stories.title: Saudi Crown Prince Arrives in Egypt

en.title: Saudi Crown Prince Arrives in Egypt
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Crown Prince has arrived in Egypt for an official visit.

stories.title: Crown Prince arrives in Cairo for talks with El-Sisi

en.title: Crown Prince arrives in Cairo for talks with El-Sisi
en.summary: Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman arrived in Cairo for discussions with Egyptian President El-Sisi on strengthening bilateral relations and addressing mutual interests.

stories.title: 13 civilians injured in Houthi attacks on three Saudi cities

en.title: 13 civilians injured in Houthi attacks on three Saudi cities
en.summary: Houthi forces launched ballistic missiles and drones at civilian areas in Khamis Mushait, Abha, and Taif, resulting in 13 civilians with minor to moderate injuries and damage to seven homes and two vehicles.

stories.title: Saudi Crown Prince to pay visit to Egypt on Tuesday

en.title: Saudi Crown Prince to pay visit to Egypt on Tuesday
en.summary: Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman will visit Egypt for talks with President Abdel Fattah El-Sisi. The leaders plan to discuss strengthening bilateral relations and regional developments.

en.title: Tadawul: Major ownership changes on Sept. 13
en.summary: Significant ownership changes are scheduled to occur on the Saudi stock exchange on September 13.

stories.title: ‎SAMA starts Mada, Himyan cards acceptance in Qatar, Saudi Arabia

en.title: SAMA starts Mada, Himyan cards acceptance in Qatar, Saudi Arabia
en.summary: The Saudi and Qatar central banks are implementing mutual acceptance of their national payment cards across both countries to strengthen regional payment integration.

stories.title: ‎Saudi-Egypt trade exchange hits SAR 444B in 10 years

en.title: Saudi-Egypt trade exchange hits SAR 444B in 10 years
en.summary: Saudi Arabia and Egypt have conducted bilateral trade totaling 444 billion Saudi riyals over the past decade, with the Kingdom maintaining a trade surplus. The two countries maintain strong economic ties across trade, investment, energy, and services sectors.

en.title: Tadawul Group finalizes 1.22M share buyback
en.summary: Saudi Tadawul Group completed a buyback of 1.22 million shares worth 151.59 million riyals for an employee stock incentive plan, at an average price of 124.25 riyals per share. The buyback was approved by the company's extraordinary general meeting in June.

stories.title: ‎Al Akaria signs SAR 463.1M contract with MOBCO

en.title: Al Akaria signs SAR 463.1M contract with MOBCO
en.summary: Saudi Real Estate Company (Al Akaria) signed a 463.13 million riyal contract with MOBCO for the first phase of the Porta Jeddah project, covering structural and mechanical works scheduled over 820 days. The contract includes construction for a hotel, façades, and public spaces.
